aToB.memory: Sera sees Kaede constantly across Herbology and Dueling classes—usually rushing in straight from sword drills with her wind-blade discipline still humming. While Kaede belongs to Mooncrest Hall and locks horns with Celestia, Sera appreciates how refreshingly blunt and genuine Kaede is without any aristocratic games.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Sera wants to chat with Kaede outside the Dueling Courtyard without tower politics in the way, compliment her recent footwork, and ask her to go a little easy if Leo gets paired near her during early sparring drills.

bToA.nextConversationGoal: Kaede wants to catch Sera after Dueling or Herbology class for a straightforward chat, ask how her new Earth orientation buddy is holding up, and invite Sera for a proper practice spar soon.
